stated: The Conservative Party will recruit 8,000 more full-time, fully warranted police officers to ensure a new police officer for every neighbourhood, dedicated to community patrolling and catching criminals.

source.quote: Recruit 8,000 more full-time, fully warranted police officers to ensure a new police officer for every neighbourhood.

bearing_set.reason: Recruiting 8,000 more warranted police officers directly affects policing capacity, community safety, crime deterrence, and law enforcement — core O5 indicators.

Recruiting 8,000 full-time warranted officers carries a material recurring cost (estimated £400m+ per year in salary, training, equipment and pensions); the policy states no funding mechanism, so it plausibly worsens the 'is spending funded vs borrowed' indicator under O12.

membership_note: O5 is the primary, designed-for outcome. O12 is included because the scale of the recruitment commitment is large enough to constitute a real fiscal signal — the concrete mechanism is a large unfunded-or-undisclosed recurring personnel cost. O10 is excluded: the policy adds more officers within existing legal powers rather than introducing new coercive or surveillance mechanisms, so the liberty effect does not clear the non-negligible bar.
